title: Make Asset Acquisition route-aware
description: Extend the existing Asset Acquisition handler to plan per-shot visual routes, generate only approved AI-image shots, preserve reusable/local image assets, and fail closed for routes without a verified acquisition adapter.
businessContext: V1 visual routing already emits reusable, document, diagram, stock, upload, and AI-image routes, but Asset Acquisition currently only accepts AI-image prompts and blocks every project without one. The application must not fabricate media or silently invoke an unrelated provider.
dependencies: existing validated image acquisition and local import services
acceptanceCriteria: Asset Acquisition evaluates the selected shots by visual route instead of requiring at least one AI-image prompt for every run.
AI-image shots still require their exact approved prompt and verified existing image capability before provider work starts.
Reuse, manual-upload, and uploaded shots preserve their existing approved local image asset without regenerating it; selective scene runs preserve unchanged assets.
Document, diagram, stock, AI-video, and text-card routes without an existing local asset fail closed with an actionable safe error, create no placeholder asset, and make no provider call.
Focused route-planning and acquisition tests, typecheck, and diff checks pass.
humanEscalationConditions: A supported non-AI route requires a new provider, renderer, persistence model, or placeholder media.
Existing local asset provenance cannot be validated safely.
